08c81f1716035b70.title: European & Western Herbalism with Sara Omanovic
08c81f1716035b70.desc: Western herbalism is a holistic approach to wellness that supports the body’s natural ability to heal, prevent disease, and maintain balance. Rooted in the traditional knowledge of European and Indigenous cultures, this practice emphasizes the use of local plants and botanical remedies to promote health. Western herbalists draw from a rich blend of folk traditions, plant energetics, and modern scientific research to create preparations such as tinctures, teas, salves, and poultices. Join us to learn all about European and Western herbalism!
